_comment: CrispEmbed OCR portfolio regression manifest. Each model entry pins the GGUF under test (repo/file/revision), a fixture image, a proven-correct expected_text (lenient CER match), and an OPTIONAL diff block. The diff block runs test-<model>-diff against a reference GGUF downloaded from HF; if that ref is absent on HF the diff step is SKIPPED (opt-in by ref presence). expected_text=null means 'not captured yet' — run with --rebake on the GPU portfolio kernel, verify the output by eye, and paste it in. See README.md. This suite exists because a vision-neck permute regression (3fb1f8e) shipped garbage OCR that a pure exit-code smoke test could not catch.

match_defaults._note: lenient char-error-rate after normalising case/punctuation/whitespace; OCR is not byte-exact across builds

diff_defaults._note: global per-stage cos_min floor; override per-stage inside a model's diff.thresholds

models.name: nafnet
models._comment: NAFNet-SIDD denoise engine (no --ocr): diff harness is the only regression signal. Guards the 2026-06 scalar->ggml conv wave — the conv2d_ggml port had scrambled every kernel (declared ne=[OC,IC,KH,KW] but PyTorch-row-major bytes) so output cratered to cos 0.538; fixed by building [KW,KH,IC,OC] kernels from the dequant bytes unchanged (like swinir) + backend-resident kernels so Metal/CUDA weights don't abort the CPU conv sched. models.name: bttr

Exact-LaTeX quality needs a diff harness (none exists yet). MUST run on a GPU build (Metal/CUDA) to exercise residency — the CPU CI cannot see this class. On the formula fixture it currently reads x=\frac{-b\pm\sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}.

models.name: fireredpunc
models._comment: FireRedPunc punctuation restoration (BERT chinese-bert-wwm-ext, 5 classes). No hidden/logits accessor in the punct C API, so the guardrail is a golden text match (run_check): a graph-scramble regression turns correct punctuation into garbage. Golden captured on the shipped q4_k (its cls head is F16 and computed in-graph via mul_mat, so weight quant is fine — unlike pcs, whose q4_k FC-head weights crash a raw tensor_get). Impl lives in CrispASR/crisp_punc (shared lib replaces the local src copy). Deterministic (argmax, no sampling).

models.name: pcs
models._comment: PCS punctuation+capitalization+segmentation (XLM-RoBERTa-base + 4 heads). Golden text-match on q8_0, which reproduces the ONNX source model EXACTLY (verified via tools/dump_pcs_reference.py: tok+post+pre+seg predictions match 11/11, encoder hidden cos 0.999997). Root causes fixed to reach parity: (1) q4_k FC-head dequant crash; (2) Unigram Viterbi tokenizer (was greedy longest-match — mis-split multi-subword words, the dominant error; needs tokenizer.ggml.scores in the GGUF); (3) decode subtoken count from actual token_ids (▁ boundaries); (4) SBD softmax P>0.05 threshold (was argmax); (5) truecase shifted is-sentence-initial conditioning; (6) exact erf GELU + LayerNorm eps 1e-5. Pinned on q8_0 (not q4_k) because q4_k's tiny truecase head has a 1-char quant-floor flip ('World'); q8_0 is exact and backend-robust at cos 0.999997. Impl in CrispASR/crisp_punc (shared lib replaces the local src copy). Deterministic (argmax/threshold, no sampling).

models.name: fullstop-punc
models._comment: Fullstop multilingual punctuation (oliverguhr/fullstop-punctuation-multilang-large, XLM-R-large) via the fireredpunc engine's SentencePiece path. Golden text-match on q4_k: this path had the full pcs bug set (greedy tokenizer, LN eps 1e-12, tanh GELU) — now Unigram Viterbi (needs tokenizer.ggml.scores), eps 1e-5, erf GELU. Engine reproduces the HF reference exactly on this sentence at q4_k/q8_0/f32 (verified vs AutoModelForTokenClassification); backend-robust (Metal==CPU). q8_0 matches HF on more borderline sentences (q4_k has occasional quant-floor punctuation flips). Requires re-converted GGUFs with scores.

models.name: decoder_embed
models._comment: Decoder-embedding engine (Qwen3/Gemma3-Embedding via crispembed_encode, no --ocr): final last-token-pooled embedding parity. Ref = tools/dump_decoder_embed_reference.py on Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (independent HF AutoModel, last-token pool + L2). Single-stage; cosine is scale-invariant. Engine (q8_0) vs f32 HF ref = cos 0.9993; floor 0.98. Guards the wave flash_attn_ext work (29d8a08); a graph scramble craters cos to ~0.

models.name: bidirlm-text

The ORIGINAL shipped GGUFs had a converter bug that cratered the text tower to cos 0.047 (0.997 vision unaffected); re-exported 2026-07-03 with the current convert-decoder-embed-to-gguf.py — text 0.9992 (q8_0) + vision still 0.997, so this one GGUF serves both bidirlm-text and bidirlm-vision. Floor 0.98.

models.name: face_detect

Guards the count + bbox/landmark pixel error; the harness emits a synthetic detection cos_min (1.0 pass / 0.0 fail) at a 12px tolerance (letterbox/resize differs slightly from insightface; engine matches within 2.45px). A graph-scramble regression yields wrong/zero detections. Fixture face.png is a FLUX-generated synthetic face (tests/regression/images/face.png), passed via diff.args.

models.name: vit_embed
models._comment: SigLIP/CLIP ViT vision encoder (no --ocr): final image-embedding parity is the regression signal. Ref = tools/dump_vit_reference.py on google/siglip-base-patch16-384 (independent HF AutoModel, get_image_features). Single-stage (C API exposes only the final embedding); cosine is scale-invariant so an L2-norm mismatch is harmless, a graph scramble craters cos to ~0. Engine vs f32 HF ref = cos 0.9915 on CPU (f16 GGUF + slow-vs-engine image preprocessing); floor 0.98 absorbs backend FP variance.

models.name: modernbert
models._comment: ModernBERT (gte-modernbert-base) encoder guardrail. Ref = dump_modernbert_reference.py (AutoModel) on a ~113-token text; span >64 so the local sliding-window layers (radius local_attention/2=64) restrict attention, guarding the SWA mask (swa_mask). q8_0 model vs f32 ref -> final_hidden 0.9919 on CPU; floor 0.99. Disabling SWA (CRISPEMBED_ENCODER_NO_SWA=1) craters cos to ~-0.87, so this catches an SWA regression.

models.name: mixtex
models.expected_text_source: captured 2026-07-02 (f16, Metal) with the HF-parity bicubic preprocessing default, after the byte-level detok fix (core_bpe::unicode_to_bytes) and the vocab_size 25678->25681 EOS fix. Guards: a detok regression leaks Ġ/Ċ; a vocab_size regression makes decode never emit EOS (runs to max_len); a preprocessing regression (e.g. reverting to bilinear via MIXTEX_BILINEAR) flips the reading.

models.name: bidirlm-vision
models._comment: BidirLM-Omni vision tower (Qwen2VL ViT + DeepStack). Ref = tools/dump_bidirlm_vision_reference.py on BidirLM/BidirLM-Omni-2.5B-Embedding (HF BidirLMOmniVisionModel, visual.* weights only, lazy safe_open). The C API (crispembed_encode_image_raw) exposes image_embeds + deepstack slabs; the harness feeds the ref's stored pixel_values/grid so preprocessing is identical. Gated on per-token MEAN cosine (test_bidirlm_vision.py's validated metric; cos_min is tanked by a few massive-activation deepstack rows that quantize poorly, not a bug). q8_0 target: image_embeds 0.997, deepstack 0.9998/0.9938; q4_k sits at its ~0.97 quant floor. A graph-scramble regression craters the mean to ~0.

models.name: clip-text
models._comment: CLIP text encoder (openai/clip-vit-base-patch16). No OCR/text output — the only regression signal is the final pooled+projected text embedding (crispembed_clip_text_encode) vs an independent HF CLIPTextModel.get_text_features reference (tools/dump_clip_text_reference.py, text 'a photo of a fox'). Guards the CLIP-BPE </w> word-boundary tokenizer (fa66a02): a GPT-2-style byte-level regression that emits a standalone space token instead of appending </w> per word craters final_embedding cos from 1.000 to ~0.79. cosine is scale-invariant so an engine/ref L2-norm mismatch is harmless; the diagnostic pre_proj line (EOS hidden, no text_proj) is printed but NOT gated (it is ~0 by design, confirming text_proj IS applied).

models.name: tromr
models._comment: Polyphonic-TrOMR OMR (ResNetV2+ViT encoder + x-transformers decoder, 4 parallel heads). Deterministic greedy argmax over rhythm/pitch/lift streams, merged to symbolic notation. expected_text is the byte-exact decode on examples/photo1.jpg (Apache-2.0), captured 2026-07-13: CPU==Metal identical, tromr-q8_0 (F16 backbone) == f32. Guards the whole OMR path (SAME-pad conv, ViT 32^-0.5 scale, scaled pos-emb, SIGLU/GEGLU, greedy argmax, detok+merge) — any regression craters the notation. The no-garbage guard passes with margin (the frequent 'note' word is 39/85 < the 0.5 repetition floor).

models.name: flova
models._comment: Flova/omr_transformer OMR (DonutSwin encoder + 4-layer mBART VED → LilyPond). Handwritten/whiteboard monophonic music. Deterministic greedy argmax over the 75-token vocab, detok to LilyPond. expected_text is the byte-exact decode on the model card's sample1.png (Apache-2.0, from Flova/omr_transformer), captured 2026-07-13 with flova-q8_0.gguf: CPU==Metal identical, q8_0 == f32 == the model-card transcription. Guards the whole VED OMR path (DonutSwin windowed attn + shifted-window mask, patch-merge downsample, final encoder LN, mBART pre-norm cross-attn, offset-2 learned positions, eos=54 stop, detok). The no-garbage guard passes with margin (top word '8' repeats 8/23 < the 0.5 repetition floor).
